mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, minihompy_id, title, content, visibility, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{minihompyId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{visibility}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, user_id, minihompy_id, title, content, visibility, view_count, like_count, comment_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
